name: BacklinkGenie
description: Hosted MCP server for link-building outreach: list sites and prospects, review, edit and approve pitches to editors, read and answer replies, import posts to pitch, and check which backlinks are live. Streamable HTTP at https://app.backlinkgenie.com/mcp with OAuth 2.1 (PKCE, dynamic client registration) or a Bearer API key. MCP access is on the Growth and Agency plans.
